title: Rory and the Misty Moonlit Hollow
verses:
The moon was a lantern of shimmering white,
And lit up the hill in the stillness of night.
Then Rory walked slow on the moss-covered ground,
Where sleepiness drifted and wrapped all around.

Up high in the sky, Nia soared through the air,
To look for a nook that was peaceful and fair.
She hummed to the stars as they started to gleam,
And guided her friends to a valley of dream.

Then Benny lay down like a cozy big hill,
While Tilly made sure that the breeze was so still.
She gathered soft clover to cushion the bed,
And patted a leaf for a resting young head.

And Ricky stopped running and stretched with a sigh,
To watch as the silvery clouds drifted by.
Psittaco nestled deep in a pocket of green,
The snuggiest spot that had ever been seen.

Then Rory let out a great big sleepy yawn,
And whispered, "Goodnight till the bright sunny dawn."
He tucked in his tail and he closed both his eyes,
Beneath the soft blanket of starlight and skies.

The valley was quiet, the dinosaurs slept,
While moonbeams of silver so tenderly crept.
So dream, little friend, as the midnight wind blows,
And rest your sweet head in a cozy repose.
